data.narrative:
Lucid Bots is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $36.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company operating in the same sector. The three most directly relevant peers—Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity—are all Series B stage robotics firms with valuations ranging from $1.6B to $2.0B.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the company's $36.4M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage step-ups, implying a valuation of $69M. The peer-median approach benchmarks against the three identified Series B robotics comparables, which have a median valuation of $1.8B (range: $1.6B–$2.0B). This method directly yields $1.8B.

The wide disparity between the two approaches reflects the fundamental tension in early-stage valuation: absolute capital raised versus relative peer positioning. The stage-progression method is mechanistic and capital-constrained; the peer-median method assumes Lucid Bots can scale toward peer valuations. The triangulated range spans $59M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $910M. The key uncertainty is whether Lucid Bots' commercial traction and technology differentiation support peer-comparable multiples or whether capital efficiency and stage timing warrant a discount to the peer set.
